_note: Performance rig for the CNMAT open lab. panelTab is deliberately absent — you do not need to be told it is a control panel while on stage. Copied from shows/shmidpoint/config.json; only the title differs.
title: CNMAT open lab
_micOnStart: Camera and mic are separate getUserMedia grants, so "it's showtime!" asks for both. This show has mic-driven puppets (bounce + talk frames) and nothing about them works without it — better one extra prompt at boot than a dead puppet on stage.
_capabilities: hands + face are the trackers; potato is the ONNX detector; faceLabels is the second ML runtime (face-api) behind the age/gender/expression box. All four are eagerly loaded at boot, so drop any this show ends up not using.
